causal_support_semantics: Feature validity requires the complete 1440-bar 4h calendar-equivalent BTC trend history.
An origin is support-eligible only when BTC_FAST_4H is finite and >= 0.
A historical eligible origin contributes to matured training support at current bar t only when origin_position + 336 <= t.
The first shadow origin is the first eligible bar whose matured eligible training-origin count reaches the track-specific training threshold.
Shadow origins are counted only after they themselves mature by 336 bars.
Formal activation occurs only at the first 168-bar refit point on the anchor-relative frozen refit grid where matured-shadow support reaches the track threshold.
Formal evaluation origins must be eligible and must retain a complete 336-bar future maturity window before the frozen dataset end.
Dependence blocks are formed from sequential ordered eligible formal origins, not raw calendar-contiguous bars; a trailing partial block is not complete.
